TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Dorsal defect of the patella, an anatomic variant. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Multifocal high-grade chondral fissuring along the medial and lateral patellar facet and at the median ridge of the patella with subchondral cystic change.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Moderate patellar chondrosis with multifocal high-grade chondral fissuring.
2. No meniscal tear or ligamentous injury.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Small joint effusion. No Bakers cyst. Small ganglion cyst associated with the medial head gastrocnemius insertion.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Degenerative multidirectional tear, with longitudinal horizontal tear at the junction of the body and posterior horn, and radial tear of the posterior horn. There is mild meniscal extrusion. Full-thickness chondral loss at the medial femoral condyle, with diffuse high-grade medial articular cartilage thinning. Small marginal osteophytes in keeping with mild medial compartment osteoarthrosis.
Thickening of the MCL with mild overlying edema in keeping with grade 1 injury.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Blunting of the inner free edge of the body of the lateral meniscus in keeping with a small partial radial tear, on a background of degenerative signal changes. Mild partial-thickness chondral thinning of lateral articular cartilage.
Normal lateral collateral ligament structures. Trace of fluid within the popliteal recess.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Mucoid degeneration of the ACL, with early ganglion cyst formation within the distal insertion. Normal PCL.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Normal extensor mechanism. Normal fat pads.
Full-thickness cartilage loss at the medial patellar articular facet with mild subchondral reactive edema.
Small marginal osteophytes in keeping with mild osteoarthrosis.

Bones:
Normal.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:
1.Tricompartmental osteoarthrosis/chondropathy as detailed above.
2.Degenerative multidirectional medial meniscal tear with mild meniscal extrusion.
3.Small lateral meniscal partial radial tear.

МР находка: Наличие на ставен излив. МР данни за дегенеративни промени в дясната колянна става. Визуализират се дребни остеофити по кондилите на фемура, тибията, както и по горната и долната повърхност на пателата. Няма костномозъчен едем. Дорзално в тибията, на залавното място на задната кръстна връзка се виждат кистични лезии с вид на дегенеративни. Дребни кистични лезии се виждат и в метафизата на фемура. Ставният хрущял на тибията и фемура от медиалната страна на ставата е леко изтънен. Медиалният менискус е изместен латерално от медиалното тибиално плато, както при екструзия. В предния и предимно в задния му рог се виждат висосигнални лезии, съоветстващи на скъсване. Дегенеративни промени се виждат и в задния рог на латералния менискус. Предната кръстна връзка е с леко повишен сигнален интензитет, но със запазена цялост. Задна кръстна връзка – б.о. Хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – б.о. Колатерални лигаменти – б.о. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – б.о. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Заключение:  МР данни за начални гонартрозни промени в дясната колянна става, изразени повече от медиалната страна. Дегенеративно-променен и скъсан медиален менискус с латерална екструзия. Дегенеративни промени в задния рог на латералния менискус. Ставен излив.
